summary: PowerBank Corporation, a Toronto-based Nasdaq-listed energy company (PBK), disclosed via Form 6-K that Nasdaq granted an additional 180-day compliance period, until March 28, 2027, to regain the US$1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company simultaneously transferred its listing from the Nasdaq Global Market to the Nasdaq Capital Market, effective October 1, 2026. Compliance requires a US$1.00 closing bid for 10 consecutive business days. Separately, certain directors, officers and consultants will adopt an automatic securities disposition plan effective October 2, 2026, with sales beginning after 90 days. Watch for reverse-split risk and insider selling overhang.
